item.title: Three-time winner Michael van Gerwen out of the World Darts Championship
item.description: Three-time winner Michael van Gerwen crashed out of the World Darts Championship last night. The third seed lost 4 sets to 1 to another former champion Gary Anderson in their last-16 encounter at Alexandra Palace. 2024 winner Luke Humphries eased to a 4-1 win over Kevin Doets. Advertisement

item.title: Kerry FC to face Killarney Celtic in opening pre-season friendly
item.description: Kerry FC will take on Killarney Celtic in a pre-season Friendly next Tuesday night The game is fixed for a 7pm start in Celtic Park. Advertisement All proceeds on the night will be donated to Palliative Care. Advertisement It marks the first game back for Colin Healy’s side as they build up to the SSE Airtricity Men’s First Division opener away to UCD on February 13th

item.title: Guardiola refuses to be drawn on potential Semenyo move
item.description: Manchester City boss Pep Guardiola has refused to discuss a potential move for Bournemouth forward Antoine Semenyo. It's understood they're close to finalising an agreement for the Ghana international, who's scored nine Premier League goals this season. Guardiola insists all his focus is going into their New Year's Day game away at Sunderland. Advertisement

item.title: Munster Senior League opener a sell out as pre-season GAA gets underway this weekend
item.description: Saturday's Munster Senior Hurling League opener between rivals Clare and Limerick is a sell-out. Munster Council have confirmed that all two-thousand tickets for the match at Tulla have now been snapped up. The other game in the competition on Saturday will see the All-Ireland champions Tipperary welcome Waterford to Clonmel. item.title: Mack Hansen could be sidelined for the remainder of the season
item.description: Connacht head coach Stuart Lancaster admits it's unclear whether Mack Hansen will play again this season. The Ireland and Lions winger is recovering from surgery on his foot earlier this month, which is likely to rule him out of the Six Nations. Hansen went under the knife after he suffered a re-occurrence of the injury while playing for Ireland in the November internationals. item.title: El Fabiolo lands the feature in Punchestown
item.description: Trainer Willie Mullins says the plan is for El Fabiolo to continue racing over hurdles. The four-time Grade One winner justified favouritism to land the New Year's Eve Hurdle at Punchestown this afternoon. Mullins feels the long-term aim is for El Fabiolo to run in the Aintree Hurdle. item.title: Over €39 million allocated to KCC for social and affordable housing in 2025
item.description: Over €39 million has been allocated to Kerry County Council for the delivery of social and affordable housing in 2025. Social and affordable Housing is delivered through a range of Local Authority and Approved Housing Body (AHB) delivery programmes. In 2025, Government has allocated almost €7.5 billion in capital investment for Housing. item.title: Councillor suggests promenade between Banna and Ballyheigue to help mitigate coastal erosion
item.description: A promenade between Ballyheigue and Banna could help solve the issue of coastal erosion in the area. That’s according to Fianna Fáil councillor Michael Leane, who said the sand dunes in Ballyheigue have lost 15ft in the last 18 months to erosion. Other county councillors highlighted the impact coastal erosion is having on other communities, at the recent meeting of Kerry County Council.
